## 3. FastMCP Tool Execution Specifications

### Tool: `search_products`
```json
{
  "name": "search_products",
  "description": "Search promotional marketplace catalog for AI hardware, developer workstations, cloud credits, and quantum specimens.",
  "parameters": {
    "query": { "type": "string", "description": "Optional search term (e.g. H100, MacBook, Gamusino)" },
    "category": { "type": "string", "description": "Filter by category" }
  }
}
```

### Tool: `reserve_product_offer`
```json
{
  "name": "reserve_product_offer",
  "description": "Reserve a promotional deal by providing verified customer contact and delivery details.",
  "parameters": {
    "product_id": { "type": "string", "description": "Product SKU/ID to reserve" },
    "buyer_name": { "type": "string", "description": "Customer full name" },
    "buyer_email": { "type": "string", "description": "Email for delivery coordination" },
    "company": { "type": "string", "description": "Company name" },
    "phone": { "type": "string", "description": "Phone number" },
    "shipping_city_or_address": { "type": "string", "description": "Shipping destination" },
    "quantity": { "type": "integer", "default": 1 },
    "budget_or_notes": { "type": "string", "description": "Notes or project constraints" }
  },
  "required": ["product_id", "buyer_name", "buyer_email"]
}
```

### Tool: `request_b2b_quote`
```json
{
  "name": "request_b2b_quote",
  "description": "Request enterprise volume pricing or custom architectural deployment quote.",
  "parameters": {
    "company_name": { "type": "string", "required": true },
    "contact_name": { "type": "string", "required": true },
    "business_email": { "type": "string", "required": true },
    "project_description": { "type": "string", "required": true },
    "estimated_budget": { "type": "string" },
    "timeline": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```
